set.body: Create a self-contained port/ workspace and an executable Stage 1 plan for a selective Python/TypeScript rebuild. Preserve the best StoryModel and StoryAtlas behavior: evidence/identity/coordinates, rich source and recall accounts, distinct reference and assessment semantics, recorded execution and offline replay, artifact-bound inspection and saved investigations. Define a small end-to-end pilot, reuse map, exact references, correctness/refusal witnesses, fair development-speed comparison, and go/no-go criteria. This bead covers planning and workspace layout only; implementation and replacement decisions are subsequent work. Keep existing Scala code, sibling checkout, data and unrelated tracker changes intact.
set.title: Plan Stage 1 Python and TypeScript pilot with preservation contracts
